project_name: Haryana Public Health Engineering Department (PHED) Water & Sewerage Utility System
archetype: Government Utility & Tactical Precision (Swiss High-Contrast + Civic Tech)

logo_and_graphics_specifications.header_badge: Government of Haryana | Public Health Engineering Dept (PHED)
logo_and_graphics_specifications.admin_header_style: High-contrast Deep Navy (#0F2942) with crisp glass blur (backdrop-blur-md), white text, gold emblem accent line
logo_and_graphics_specifications.surveyor_header_style: Clean White base (#FFFFFF) with 1px border-b (#E2E8F0), prominent PHED logo icon, active town badge, surveyor status toggle

bottom_navigation.structure: Fixed 3-tab bottom bar with touch-friendly 64px height and clear visual indicators

excel_queue_view.description: Lists PHED Public Health Excel consumer records requiring physical property verification and linkage
record_card_fields: PHED Consumer Account No / Book No

property_linker_modal_flow.step_1: Click on PHED Excel consumer item in Water Survey queue
property_linker_modal_flow.step_3: Type MC Property ID or Owner Name -> query matching MC Property records
property_linker_modal_flow.step_4: Select matching MC Property ID card (`data-testid="select-property-card-XXX"`)
property_linker_modal_flow.step_5: Click Attach Property ID (`data-testid="btn-confirm-attach-property"`) -> submit linkage to database

pending_45s_timer_rule.description: When a surveyor attaches a Property ID or updates survey details, an inline live ticker shows 'Pending Verification (Auto-confirm in 45s)' with a visual countdown radial/progress bar

admin_panel_specifications.sidebar: Dark slate navy sidebar with PHED Haryana branding, quick access to PHED Imports, Water Surveys, Submissions, Map View, and Analytics

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace old/generic graphics with the refreshed Haryana PHED logo (/phed-logo.png) in header, login, admin sidebar, and surveyor app header.
2. In Surveyor App (Employee Dashboard/Layout), provide a clear 3-point bottom navigation bar: Home (home), Properties (properties), and Water Survey (water_survey).
3. Under 'Water Survey' tab, render the Public Health PHED Excel uploaded consumer dataset list.
4. Allow surveyors to click any PHED consumer record, search for an MC Property ID, preview property owner/address details, and attach the Property ID.
5. Implement the 45-second pending change indicator UI timer ('Change pending approval / auto-syncing in 45s') for newly updated linkages.
6. Polish the Admin Panel with high-contrast utility dashboard metrics, excel consumer import table, and linked property validation tools.
7. Add data-testid attributes to all tabs, search inputs, attach buttons, modal triggers, and status badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop, soft transparent dropdowns without backgrounds, and center-everything layouts.
Ensure contrast meets WCAG AA / APCA standards for field accessibility under sunlight.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, and card.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for header menus or modal overlays.
